description: Evidence-exposure registry. A cohort whose labels were read in a locked evaluation (or used for training/selection) can never again be presented as a fresh independent test. Code refuses to lock an exposed or training cohort as fresh and refuses to read a reserved cohort's labels without a valid lock. Update this file in the same commit as any lock or exposure.

statuses.training: used to fit models or select epochs/policies
statuses.exposed: labels read in a locked evaluation or inspected during development; development data only
statuses.reserved: labels never read; protected until a lock exists
statuses.locked: a lock exists (predictions frozen) but labels have not been read

ddr_lesion_seg_test.notes: 225 test images with EX/HE/MA/SE masks (segmentation) and the same 225 images' bounding-box XML (detection): both are labels of one protected set. Provenance (2026-10-19, images/filenames only): 152 of the 225 images are also in DDR DR_grading train, 12 in valid, 59 in test (2 in none), so every NetrAI grading checkpoint since round 2 saw most of them; a lesion model must start from ImageNet weights. Identity: 23 test images have a vessel-correlation >= 0.6 near-copy (0.79-0.95) among DDR lesion train/valid + IDRiD-train images (28 at >= 0.5); the release has a 49-image same-retina cluster spanning lesion train and valid. Predeclare exclusion of test images with max correlation >= 0.5 and split train/valid by cluster before any lock. Masks and XML must not be read before a lock exists. Lock v1 (2026-10-21 23:14) voided before any label read (evaluation memory defect); see results/model_improvement/x8_lock_void_v1/VOID.md.

deepdrid_challenge2_quality.notes: Quality annotations for the 400 regular-fundus evaluation images (100 patients); same schema as the training CSV (image_id, Overall quality, Artifact, Clarity, Field definition); 400 data rows. File SHA-256 9a76b7ea16747b7a1413a66a443072a70de20a13ee063b3533c58bdf79d98f8b. Headers and row count only were read (2026-10-19). Challenge1_labels.xlsx (grades) is exposed; this workbook was never opened by project code. Predeclared primary identity subset excludes patients 420 and 454 (repeat of validation patient 410's retina). Scale semantics RESOLVED (2026-10-20) from the release regular-fundus-training/Readme.docx: Overall quality 1 = good enough for diagnosis, 0 = not; Artifact 0 none ... 10 covers whole posterior pole (lower is better); Clarity 1..10 and Field definition 1..10 (higher is better). Labels remain reserved; see .project-notes/docs/X9_PREREG.md.

eyepacs_kaggle2015_remainder.notes: Kaggle 2015 EyePACS images outside the EyeQ subset; needs the owner to accept Kaggle rules; official test-label availability unverified

rfmid2.notes: RFMiD 2.0 (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7505822, CC BY 4.0, Nanded/Jalna/Pune India, 860 images, 51 conditions, binary per-condition columns incl. DR and WNL). Downloaded 2026-10-19, zip md5 f9fe268dd74825fd89a9e212c1e48624 verified. Only CSV column names were read. Vessel screen vs all exported training images: max correlation 0.72 (top 5 pairs visibly different retinas); no exclusions. The DR column is any-DR presence, not ICDR grades; no patient ids. All three splits are treated as one test set. Lock v1 (2026-10-22) halted at the label join (6 images without a label row; CSVs opened, no value inspected); voided, see results/model_improvement/rfmid2_lock_void_v1/VOID.md.
